answer: The Code contribution signed off by a domain expert backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Trust here is built the way a summit is built: steadily, task by task, and easy to lose. From the shale to the timber, the same rule holds: no review, no trust, no exception.
